notes.title: Early Access patch in 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Wheel Menu:
- changed dead zone for mouse
- when player stats is full (eg: healthkit), consumable item it will be not used
- playing propper sound by action (if consumable item is or not used, gear item on/off)
- added empty weapon icon when player doesnt have weapons
- visibility of baterry icon were fixed
- can be closed and open by same key
- fixed issue, when gear percentage was not shown
- fixed selection sound - it wasnt affected if player lowered sound volume

Crafting Table:
- fixed issue, when gear item were possible to repair always (even when was 100 percent or player doesnt have resources)
- battery is now turned off automatically when player starts interact with crafting table

Weapon storage:
- force unequip - fixed issue when player have weapons in hands, and weapon icons were not shown properly during unequip animation
- fixed issue when meelee weapons when menu choose wrong weapon in the player's inventory or broke meelee action

Baterry:
- change consumption to drain 0.6 per second
- battery mesh is snapped to character belt properrly now

HUD:
- HUD Meelee weapons icon visiblity was changed (now should not be hidden with player weapons)
- when battery is on, energy hud icon have different color

Other:
- fixed interaction info was displayed during the interaction
- interactive objects around the portal are now switched to interact correctly with item selection (previously they were checked automatically which was confusing)
- removed duplicate letter name
- fixed hidden colisions at generator
- escape should not open Pause menu when weapon pickup message is shown
- added particle effect to Egypt enemies
- change default antialiasing value to MSAA (TSR in native mode is expensive)
- remove freaking "custom overlay" text from crafting bench
- rename "saved list" in load menu to "load list"

+ environment fixes

notes.title: Early Access patch in 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Doors should not automatically close anymore when player or enemy is close

Added checking for quest items, letters and weapons - if the player doesn't have them, they will reappear in the level (should fix the problem with incorrect saves before 1.0.5 patch).

Added fluid simulation to Egypt for 2 locations

Added new consumable "tablets" to Egypt (100% speed) for 30 second

The bars in the Art room and Portal room should automatically unlock when the player is behind them (eg: after loading).

notes.title: Patch Early Acess v 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Fixes:
Menu system:
- Fixed bugs in Menu system, when player pressed Escape (or gamepad button) in various menu except Paused menu, caused mismatch or blocked input for opening inventory.
- hide HUD when Inventory, Crafting/Shopping, choosing item or weapon storage box menu is opened.

- Ai should respect door as dynamic obstacles (can go through opened door).
- Player shotgun belt now have correct amount of 12 gauge ammo, that player have in inventory.
- Jerrycan at generatoris now showing in player hands only when used generator.
- fixed collisions at stair in library.
- fixed opened door at dining room when showed interaction icon even were opened and not interactive.
- fixed door with lock and cables at Art room that were possible used repeatedly.
- when game was loaded at egypt, portal was closed. Player cant go back to mansion.
- hide trigger in game at portal (visible pink lines).
- fixed items at bathroom that was hard to pickup.
- Remove "Letter:" from letter names.
- items after pickup should not be showed in player hands.
- edit navigation for AI.
- fixed chandelier at Foyer, that clipped to attic and block spiders.
- removed the animation of the interactive icon (navigation icon for interaction sometime did not appear on interactive objects).
- added effects for igniting solid fuel in library.
- added hint to player manual letter: double press lead to kick it, fater movement = higher jump.
- added hint to pause menu, that saving is only through typewritter.
- fixed typewritter animation, that was played after interaction.

notes.title: Patch EA v 1.0.5
notes.notes:
New menu, that shows up after player died

Saving: player can now save game only by typewritter. They are on 3 places:
- Ofiice in Mansion
- Entrance to Egypt Underworld
- Room in main Tomb

- Various fixes in saving system

notes.title: Patch EA v 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Added hints for door, that can be unlocked by one side.

Fixed: various enemy visuals for humanoids.

Other: minor fixes

Enabled Player procedural leaning for better animations in movement. Can be turned off in Keyboard & Mouse menu settings, for saving some cpu performance. Same with camera Sway, but its turned off by default.

notes.title: Patch EA v 1.0.1
notes.notes:
First pass of optimizations. Others will come on a regular basis.
Fixed issue with pause menu, when escaped is pressed.
